column1: # Logical key name -> per-host key identifier. One source for every backend:
# bash reads column 2/3, PowerShell reads column 4, so a key recipe written in
# a skill or an observation record names the logical key and stays portable.
# macos  = CGEvent virtual keycode (US layout). macOS has no Scroll Lock or
#          PrintScreen keycode; a PC keyboard's Scroll Lock/PrintScreen arrive
#          as F14/F13, which is what the guest sees.
